en: Colorized historic view of a European city gate and street. Two round medieval stone towers with conical red roofs stand on either side of a main street lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings. A tall church or town‑hall spire rises in the background. Horse‑drawn carriages and early trams or carts are visible on the street. Handwritten text is in red and purple ink at the bottom left, and printed captions and publisher information appear along the lower edge.
